domains.label: Page X-Ray
checks: Run /page-xray --delta for every affected route, or --quick for a newly created route.
Update docs/xrays findings and developer notes when the page shape changed.

domains.label: Universal Rail Intelligence
checks: Verify lib/discovery/rail-profiles.ts has a matching surface profile.
Verify relevant resolvers exist in lib/discovery/resolvers and produce contextual cards.

domains.label: Remy, Navigation, Command Surface
checks: Verify new pages/actions are discoverable through nav, command surface, Remy, or a justified local entry point.
Verify no functional route is stranded without an inbound path.

domains.label: Communications and Notifications
checks: Verify user-visible state changes notify the right party or appear in the correct inbox/feed.
Verify communications are threaded, tenant-scoped, and do not duplicate notifications.

domains.label: Menu Intelligence
checks: Verify menu, recipe, dish, dietary, and approval changes feed menu intelligence surfaces.
Verify menu intelligence cards or panels appear where chefs make menu decisions.

domains.label: Commitment UI and Completion
checks: Verify the feature updates readiness, commitment, or completion state when it changes booking confidence.
Verify the UI distinguishes draft, proposed, committed, paid, confirmed, and complete states.

domains.label: Ledger, Finance, Payments
checks: Verify money movement creates immutable ledger/payment records and avoids destructive changes.
Verify finance and rail summaries reflect payment, invoice, and revenue changes.

domains.label: PIE and Pricing Intelligence
checks: Verify pricing, ingredient, recipe, quote, and procurement work uses PIE or records why PIE is not applicable.
Verify pricing outputs do not hide failures as zeros or stale certainty.

domains.label: Priority Queue and Action Graph
checks: Verify new waiting work, blockers, overdue work, or next actions appear in Priority Queue or Action Graph.
Verify actions have source, urgency, due state, and deep links.

domains.label: Automation and CIL
checks: Verify durable signals, automation hooks, and intelligence outputs are emitted where the feature creates new evidence.
Verify signal freshness and suppression rules are respected.

domains.label: Event Lifecycle and FSM
checks: Verify event mutations use the canonical transition path where lifecycle state changes.
Verify dependent surfaces update after lifecycle transitions.

domains.label: Client Intelligence
checks: Verify client-facing or client-derived facts feed the client intelligence ledger or summary.
Verify sensitive client intelligence is role-gated and tenant-scoped.

domains.label: Dinner Circles
checks: If two parties interact around an event, inquiry, recurring client, staff assignment, or community group, verify an ensure*Circle or create*Circle path.
Verify important lifecycle updates post to the relevant Circle feed when user-visible.
